speaker: Leonard
text: I drove, mother. I'm driving now.

speaker: Beverly
text: It was so nice of you to come all the way down to the airport to pick me up. Yes, dear, mommy's proud. I've been meaning to thank you for your notes on my paper disproving quantum brain dynamic theory.

speaker: Sheldon
text: No trouble at all. My pleasure. For a non-physicist, you have a remarkable grasp of how electric dipoles in the brain's water molecules could not possibly form a Bose condensate.

speaker: Leonard
text: Wait, wait, wait. When did you send my mom notes on a paper?

speaker: Sheldon
text: August 16th. Right after her carpal tunnel surgery.

speaker: Beverly
text: Oh, did I thank you for the flowers? I don't really like flowers.

speaker: Sheldon
text: You did. Neither do I, but it's a social convention.

speaker: Beverly
text: It is, isn't it?

speaker: Leonard
text: Wait, wait, wait, you had surgery?

speaker: Beverly
text: Yes, and Sheldon sent me flowers. Then what was all that wait, wait, wait about?

speaker: Leonard
text: I heard that.

speaker: Leonard
text: I just don't understand why he knows more about your life than I do.

speaker: Beverly
text: Well, I would assume it's because Sheldon and I stay in touch due to mutual interest and respect while you avoid me due to unresolved childhood issues.

speaker: Sheldon
text: It's what we think caused your narcissistic personality disorder. We discussed it at length during our last video chat. Although how it got onto the subject of you is baffling.

speaker: Beverly
text: Yes, but we are on the subject, so I'm obliged to ask, Leonard, how are you?

speaker: Leonard
text: Fine, mom. How are you?

speaker: Beverly
text: Hm, menopausal.

speaker: Leonard
text: Now I'm less fine.

speaker: Beverly
text: Have you heard your brother has gotten engaged?

speaker: Leonard
text: No. Sheldon, why didn't you tell me?

speaker: Sheldon
text: My bad. I did send a gift from both of us.

speaker: Beverly
text: She's a remarkable girl. The youngest appeals court judge in New Jersey and a two-time Olympic bronze medalist.

speaker: Leonard
text: You must be very happy.

speaker: Beverly
text: Why, I'm not marrying her. So how about you? Are you seeing anyone interesting?

speaker: Sheldon
text: Well, I'm not sure about interesting, but...

speaker: Leonard
text: Not the time, Sheldon.

speaker: Sheldon
text: Very well. Shall we switch topics to Isaac Newton v Gottfried Leibniz?

speaker: Beverly
text: It's all right, Sheldon. I will just pretend that Leonard's not withholding information. Although I will point out, Leonard, that I am a trained psychiatrist, and you are exhibiting the same secretive behavioral tics that accompanied your learning to masturbate.
